titles.tr: ChatGPT Slides ile Hızlı Sunum Hazırlama
titles.en: Build Decks Fast With ChatGPT Slides

topics.angle: how-to — Using ChatGPT Slides (launched Oct 2026) to go from a rough outline to a presentable marketing or pitch deck. Outline: structuring the prompt (audience, narrative arc, slide count); keeping brand consistency; editing generated slides; exporting; and where a human still has to take over (data accuracy, design polish).
keyClaimsToVerify: ChatGPT Slides launched ~Oct 16 2026 and availability by plan

titles.tr: Konu Kümeleri ve Sütun Sayfaları ile SEO
titles.en: Topic Clusters and Pillar Pages for SEO

topics.angle: how-to — Build a pillar-and-cluster structure that signals topical authority to both Google and AI answer engines. Outline: pick the pillar topic; map the cluster of supporting articles; internal-linking rules (cluster->pillar and back); avoiding keyword cannibalization; measuring whether the hub lifts the whole cluster.
keyClaimsToVerify: How clustering + internal linking is understood to help in the AI-search era
suggestedSources: Verify current SEO guidance at write time

titles.en: Why Your Cold Email Hits Spam (and Fixes)

topics.angle: mistakes — The technical and behavioral reasons cold email lands in spam, and a fix checklist. Outline: authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and the 2024 Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender rules; domain and inbox warmup; list hygiene and consent; copy triggers; sending volume ramps; measuring deliverability vs. open rate.
keyClaimsToVerify: Gmail/Yahoo 2024 bulk-sender requirements (SPF+DKIM+DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, spam-rate threshold) still in force
Whether DMARC is now effectively mandatory

topics.angle: comparison — What Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) actually adds over 6E and who benefits in 2026. Outline: the headline features (Multi-Link Operation, 320 MHz channels, 4K-QAM); real-world throughput vs. marketing numbers; device and ISP realities; whether to upgrade router + clients together or wait; home-mesh considerations.
keyClaimsToVerify: Wi-Fi 7 feature set and certification status
Client-device availability and realistic throughput in 2026

titles.en: Build Your Own Home Server in 2026

topics.angle: guide — Why people run a homelab in 2026 (self-hosted media, backups, ad-blocking, local AI) and how to start without overbuilding. Outline: pick a base (mini PC or NAS); the OS/containers layer (Docker/compose); a starter service set; backups and remote access safely; and the honest power, noise, and maintenance reality.
keyClaimsToVerify: Popular self-hosted stacks and starter hardware in 2026
Typical idle power draw of mini-PC/NAS setups

titles.tr: Yıllık mı Aylık mı? Hangi Planı Öne Çıkarmalı?
titles.en: Annual vs Monthly: Which Plan to Push?

topics.angle: comparison — The real tradeoffs between pushing annual vs. monthly plans. Outline: annual = upfront cash, lower churn, but higher CAC payback and refund risk; monthly = easier yes, higher churn; how to size the annual discount; defaulting the right one by company stage; the UX of offering both without confusing buyers.
keyClaimsToVerify: Observed churn differences between annual and monthly cohorts

titles.en: The Mom Test: Better Customer Interviews

topics.angle: guide — Why asking 'would you buy this?' produces false positives, and the Mom Test rules that fix it. Outline: talk about their life and past behavior, not your idea; ask about real problems and what they already spend time/money on; avoid compliments and hypotheticals; question templates; red flags; turning answers into decisions.
keyClaimsToVerify: Rob Fitzpatrick's core Mom Test principles are represented accurately
Common interview mistakes the book names
